description.value: Seoul Hotdog UBC is a Korean-style quick-service restaurant on the UBC campus specializing in corn-dog-style hotdogs with a wide range of fillings, from kimchi and bulgogi to shrimp and pizza. Beyond hotdogs, the menu spans Korean dumplings (mandu), K-pancakes, rice bowls, and shaved-ice bingsu desserts. It sits on University Boulevard in the heart of the UBC campus, making it a convenient refuelling stop for cyclists riding through the university endowment lands.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (20 spaces, covered) at 42m; stands (10 spaces, covered) at 82m. Total: 30 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business is open and actively taking orders at 6133 University Blvd, Vancouver, BC, with phone (778) 883-2464 — all matching OSM tags exactly. The site is a Korean-style hotdog and quick-service food counter with online pickup ordering, confirming takeout capability. No evidence is present on the website or in OSM tags for bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any other cyclist-specific amenities.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible food business on the UBC campus with a confirmed website and active online ordering. A practical refuelling stop for cyclists in the university endowment lands area.
